title: 第三千五百九十一章 思索第三千五百九十章 转移
content_zh:
听完韦德的话，中间人突然诡异的笑了笑，接着，祂朝韦德道：“韦德，我曾仔细分析过你，并且总结了观众们为什么喜欢你。”
虽然中间人被安德鲁坑了，处在发疯的边缘，但祂毕竟是大佬级人物，该有的智慧，格局和能力，还是有的。
“当然是因为我帅，还能是因为什么？”
韦德耸了耸肩，一脸自信的说道：“无论是当演员，还是当漫画人物，最重要的就是帅，只要够帅，就一定会有粉丝。
以前反派的形象，大多数是丑陋，邪恶，阴森，会吓到小孩子的那种，虽然的确很符合人物的设定，但不会给电影增加额外的票房，也卖不了什么周边。
因此，后来资本家们把反派弄的十分英俊，又或者有个性，反正就是用各种方法增加魅力，这样做，不仅能增加票房收入，还能给电影带来更多粉丝，更多好处。
总之一句话，帅，真的能当饭吃。”
韦德这句话，并不能算错，别说正经电影，就是喜剧，主角同样要比较帅，这个世界，终究是个看脸的世界。
“你没毁容前，确实很帅。”
中间人看了一眼旁边韦德的新身躯，说道：“不过，你大多数时候，都是戴着面具，而面具下，更是一张毁容脸。
所以，大家喜欢你，不是因为你帅，而是因为你与众不同，和传统的超级英雄完全不一样，同时，诙谐幽默，没底线，满嘴粗话，还总能让人捧腹大笑。”
“你说的那些优点，我的确是有，但他们之所以喜欢看我，主要原因还是因为我帅。”
韦德仰着头望着自己的新身躯，口水差点流下来：“真的好帅，呃，如果你不介意的话，可以离开一会吗？我想自己跟自己来一下。”
“不行，这具身体里也有我的意识，我不想跟你来一下。”
中间人翻了个白眼，继续道：“同时，观众老爷们还喜欢看你冒险的故事。
韦德，如果有一天，你认识了个美女，决定和她归隐，冒险生活变成一个小男人的日常，你说，观众们还会继续喜欢你吗？”
“当然会，因为我帅，帅哥无论演什么，观众们都喜欢。”
韦德理所当然的说道，中间人摇了摇头，说道：“不会的，韦德，你这辈子都讨不到老婆，因为观众老爷们不喜欢。
如果这是真实世界，你做什么都行，但如果这真的是漫画世界，那么，一旦你娶老婆归隐，你老婆马上就会死，然后，你为了复仇，再次走上冒险的路。
你永远不死，什么事都能由着自己的性子来，自由自在，听起来确实很好，但其实，你是被限定在一个框架里的宠物。

身为漫画人物，无论是有人气，还是没人气，都是一种悲哀。”
“什么？”
韦德有点懵逼，以他的智商，真的想不到这些事，现在中间人说出来，他感觉自己脑子要炸了，这是我能听的东西？怎么感觉真的要疯了啊？
见到韦德懵逼的模样，中间人忍不住哈哈大笑，认识韦德这么久，一直以来，都是祂用各种话碾压自己，现在自己终于反过来碾压祂了，痛快，真是痛快。
“韦德，这种费脑子的事，你还是不要多想了，免得脑子炸开，跟以前一样没心没肺才是最好的，这种麻烦的东西，留着我自己慢慢想。”
中间人望着韦德说道，韦德眨了眨眼，刚想说什么，脑海里与这段对话有关的记忆全部消失不见。
“我似乎忘了什么？呃，随便了，反正我天天忘事，那些追债的家伙真恶心，我犯了病忘记欠他们的钱，他们不仅不同情我，还要砍我。”
韦德挠了挠头，吐槽道，中间人说道：“你那叫故意赖账。”
“胡说，我怎么可能赖账，谁不知道我韦德，是出了名的有诚信？”
韦德怒道：“你现在立刻向我道歉，只要你向我道歉，我就同意把身体借给你使用，不要这样看着我，我们出来混的，最重要的是面子。”
中间人摇了摇头，这么个条件，就把自己的身体借出去，如果是其他人，要么是脑袋被驴踢了，要么是有坑，呃，如果是机械魔王，那铁定是有坑，而且是超级大的坑。
但这是韦德说的话，那就再正常不过，毕竟，一个神经病做什么事都正常。
“我向你道歉。”
中间人说道，韦德哈哈大笑，仿佛赢了一场大战役一样，接着，他又开始望着自己的身体流口水，实在是太帅了。
“啧啧，中间人这进化速度，比我想象中更快啊，而且祂的实力，也比想象中更强一点，居然无声无息的就抹去了韦德一段记忆。”
安德鲁啧啧称奇，什么，他怎么知道韦德和中间人的对话？这不废话吗，以安德鲁的性格，铁定在韦德身上做了很多手脚，这些手脚，足以让他知晓韦德身边发生的一切。
安德鲁布了一个这么大的局，不可能不管不顾，所以，他一直在借助韦德监视中间人。
在安德鲁一步步的算计中，中间人成功掉坑里，离疯狂只有一步之遥，但祂毕竟不是一般的存在，并没有停留在真相的表面，而是不停探索真相的核心，连韦德都被祂说的懵逼。
现在中间人在某方面的段位，比韦德这个老江湖更高。
同时，中间人的实力也突飞猛进，安德鲁摸了摸下巴，没有多做什么，一方面，虽然中间人那边有点变故，但总体来说，还在安德鲁的掌控之中。

毕竟，中间人现在的目标依然是创造剧本世界，以寻求世界的真实，并没有偏离安德鲁挖的这个大坑。
只要没有偏离这个大坑，一切都好说，因为掉进大坑，中间人一定会发疯。
另一方面，中间人的实力确实变强了，但不好意思，安德鲁的实力更强，他最让人恐怖的地方就在于，他不仅实力强悍，提升速度，还远超其他人。
中间人提升的速度已经非常可怕，但比起安德鲁，根本算不了什么。
content_en:
After listening to Wade's words, the middleman suddenly smiled strangely, and then he said to Wade: "Wade, I have carefully analyzed you and summarized why the audience likes you."
Although the middleman was deceived by Andrew and was on the verge of going crazy, he was a boss-level figure after all, and he still had the wisdom, structure, and abilities he should have.
"Of course it's because I'm handsome, what else could it be?"
Wade shrugged and said confidently: "Whether you are an actor or a comic character, the most important thing is to be handsome. As long as you are handsome enough, you will definitely have fans.
In the past, most villains were ugly, evil, gloomy, and would scare children. Although they were indeed in line with the character's setting, they would not add extra box office to the movie, and they would not sell any peripherals.
Therefore, later the capitalists made the villains very handsome, or had personalities, anyway, they used various methods to increase their charm. This would not only increase box office revenue, but also bring more fans and more benefits to the movie.
In short, he is handsome and can really be eaten. "
Wade's words are not wrong. Let alone serious movies, they are comedies, and the protagonists should also be handsome. This world is, after all, a world of appearance.
"You were indeed handsome before you were disfigured."
The middleman glanced at Wade's new body next to him and said, "However, you wear a mask most of the time, and under the mask, you have a disfigured face.
Therefore, everyone likes you, not because you are handsome, but because you are different and completely different from traditional superheroes. At the same time, you are humorous, have no bottom line, are full of foul language, and can always make people laugh. "
"I do have the advantages you mentioned, but the main reason why they like to look at me is because I'm handsome."
Wade looked up at his new body and almost drooled: "It's really handsome. Uh, if you don't mind, can you leave for a while? I want to do it by myself."
"No, this body also has my consciousness, and I don't want to come with you."
The middleman rolled his eyes and continued: "At the same time, the audience also likes to read your adventure stories.
Wade, if one day you meet a beautiful woman and decide to live in seclusion with her, and your adventurous life becomes the daily routine of a little man, do you think the audience will continue to like you? "
"Of course I will, because I'm handsome and the audience likes me no matter what I do."
Wade said matter-of-factly, and the intermediary shook his head and said: "No, Wade, you will never get a wife in this life because the gentlemen in the audience don't like it.
If this is the real world, you can do whatever you want, but if this is really the comic book world, then once you marry your wife and go into seclusion, your wife will die immediately, and then, for revenge, you will embark on the road of adventure again.
You will never die, and you can do everything according to your own temper. It sounds really good, but in fact, you are a pet limited to a frame.
As a comic book character, whether he is popular or not, it is a kind of tragedy. "
"What?"
Wade was a little confused. With his IQ, he really couldn't have thought of these things. Now that the middleman said it, he felt like his brain was going to explode. Is this something I can hear? Why do you feel like you are really going crazy?
Seeing Wade's confused look, the middleman couldn't help laughing. He had known Wade for so long, and he had been crushing him with all kinds of words. Now he was finally crushing him in turn. It was so happy, so happy.
"Wade, you'd better not think too much about such troublesome things, lest your brain explode. It's best to be as heartless as before. I'll leave such troublesome things for myself to think about slowly."
The intermediary looked at Wade and said. Wade blinked. Just as he was about to say something, the memory related to this conversation came to his mind.All disappeared.
"I seem to have forgotten something? Uh, whatever, anyway, I forget things every day. Those debt collectors are so disgusting. I got sick and forgot the money I owed them. Not only did they not sympathize with me, they even wanted to kill me."
Wade scratched his head and complained, and the intermediary said: "You are deliberately defaulting on the bill."
"Nonsense, how could I default on my debt? Who doesn't know that I, Wade, am known for my integrity?"
Wade said angrily: "You apologize to me now. As long as you apologize to me, I will agree to lend you my body. Don't look at me like this. We are here to hang out. The most important thing is face."
The middleman shook his head. He lent his body on such a condition. If it were anyone else, his head would have been kicked by a donkey, or there would be a trap. Well, if it was the Mechanical Demon King, there would definitely be a trap, and it would be a huge trap.
But this is what Wade said, and it's perfectly normal. After all, everything a lunatic does is normal.
"I apologize to you."
The middleman said, Wade laughed as if he had won a big battle, and then he started drooling looking at his body, it was so handsome.
"Tsk, tsk, the speed of the evolution of the middleman is faster than I imagined, and his strength is also a little stronger than imagined. He actually erased a part of Wade's memory silently."
Andrew clicked his tongue in surprise, what, how did he know about the conversation between Wade and the middleman? Isn't this nonsense? With Andrew's character, he must have done a lot of tricks on Wade. These tricks were enough to let him know everything that happened around Wade.
Andrew has set up such a big scheme, and it is impossible to ignore it, so he has been using Wade to monitor the middleman.
In Andrew's step-by-step calculation, the middleman successfully fell into the trap and was only one step away from madness. But after all, he was not an ordinary existence. He did not stay on the surface of the truth, but kept exploring the core of the truth. Even Wade was confused by what he said.
Now the middleman's rank in certain aspects is higher than that of Wade.
At the same time, the strength of the middleman also increased by leaps and bounds. Andrew touched his chin and did not do much. On the one hand, although there were some changes on the middleman's side, overall, it was still under Andrew's control.
After all, the current goal of The Inbetweener is still to create a scripted world in order to seek the reality of the world, and has not deviated from the big hole dug by Andrew.
As long as we don't deviate from this big pit, everything is easy to say, because if we fall into this big pit, the middlemen will definitely go crazy.
On the other hand, the strength of the middleman has indeed become stronger, but sorry, Andrew is stronger. The most terrifying thing about him is that he is not only powerful and fast, but also far superior to others.
The speed at which middlemen are improving is already terrifying, but compared to Andrew, it is nothing.
